title: Where to reach this app
description: Every address this app answers on right now, and which port it uses.

note.container: The port the app listens on inside its container.
note.host: The port published on this server for the container port.
note.hostStopped: The app is not running, so no host port is published.
note.hostNone: No host port is published yet. Redeploy to publish one.
note.localNone: Available once the app is running.
note.lan: Reachable from other devices on the same network.
note.lanLocalhost: Not reachable from the network: the port is bound to localhost.
note.lanRemote: This app runs on another node. Open that node to see its network addresses.
note.public: Plain HTTP on a public interface. TLS and sign-in gates do not apply.
note.domain: Served through the proxy with TLS.
note.internal: Other apps on this server reach it by this name and port.

allow.title: Allow network access?
allow.description: The port is published on every interface and opened in the host firewall, so other devices can reach this app over plain HTTP.
allow.plain_http: Plain HTTP: traffic is not encrypted and sign-in gates configured on the domain do not apply on this port.
allow.recreates: The container is recreated with the new settings.

errors.load: Could not load the app addresses.

empty: No addresses yet. Deploy the app to get one.

traffic.hint: No traffic yet. Charts appear when the first request arrives.
